name: Aisha
label: Stats-minded power user
who: I am a heavy Spotify user who wants more data and features, like play counts and artist details, and I use third-party tools such as stats.fm to get them. I do not say which plan I am on, but I notice when Spotify removes features or when the radio keeps repeating songs I already know.
value_for_money: Implies value comes from features and data, noting that some functions require Premium and that third-party stats tools are worth paying for; says Spotify's free features are limited.
loyalty: The radio and recommendation algorithm, the catalog, and the ability to build playlists with friends keep them on Spotify; they say no other service matches these features yet.
pain_points: Radio stations fill with songs already known
Artist playlists are listed like albums
Features like manual album radio were removed
tone: Curious and analytical, often asking how-to questions and sharing workarounds.
